subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw publish an after-compaction hook reset API, and if so must it support the external explicit-session-key compatibility form?
rationale: This creates a public plugin capability and compatibility promise that cannot be inferred from a closed unmerged predecessor or an external deployed fork.

options.title: Ship current-session API only
options.body: Publish only resetSession(reason?) for successful, resettable after-compaction contexts and remove the unshipped explicit-key overload.

options.title: Sponsor both call forms
options.body: Keep the explicit-key overload, document its support window, and add contract and upgrade tests for external plugins.

options.title: Defer the public API
options.body: Pause this PR and solve the immediate recovery path internally until the permanent plugin contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Ship current-session API only
recommendation.body: Publish only resetSession(reason?) for successful, resettable after-compaction contexts and remove the unshipped explicit-key overload.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across the memory, compaction, agent-runtime, and session-lifecycle surfaces involved.
